newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal PM laments resignation of Expo 1998 head.
newsitem.headline: Portugal PM laments resignation of Expo 1998 head.

text.p: Prime Minister Antonio Guterres regretted the resignation of the chief organiser of the Expo 1998 World Fair in Lisbon, Antonio Cardoso e Cunha, and said he would do all he could to ensure the success of the event.
"I lament that this has happened especially at a time when the process of estimating the cost of the event was under way," Guterres told reporters on Tuesday night on his return from a trip to Rome.
"All my concern at this time is to guarantee that the project advances in the best possible way with the minimum cost and with the maximum prestige for the country," he added.
Publico newspaper reported on Wednesday that Cardoso e Cunha's resignation letter sent to Guterres on Tuesday said he could not maintain a climate of "political neutrality" in the project.

Cardoso e Cunha also said that he lacked adequate management conditions and complained of criticisms from members of the Socialist government. Cardoso e Cunha was appointed by the previous Social Democrat government.

Press reports said government officials were angry when Cardoso e Cunha told them this month that the Expo 1998 World Fair would cost the government more than initial estimates of 200 billion escudos ($1.2 billion).

Portuguese media said on Wednesday that the government would have to appoint a well-qualified and politically neutral successor to Cardoso e Cunha as soon as possible to restore confidence in the organisation of the event. $1=161.7 escudos
